scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd apps/api && bun x prisma migrate dev'
scripts.db:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd apps/api && bun x prisma migrate deploy'
scripts.db:studio: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd apps/api && bun x prisma studio'
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd apps/api && bun x prisma migrate reset'
